task.title: Reading the configuration file from a standalone deployment by using Podman
task.shortdesc: To obtain configuration information for your Red Hat Quay deployment and troubleshoot issues, you can use podman cp or podman exec for standalone deployments. You can then update your config.yaml file, search the Red Hat Knowledgebase, or file a support ticket.
